Harbor State exposure: $42.0mm FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP, $18.0mm FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING, and $35.5mm FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC.

Monthly BDC note

Overall, the portfolio exposure remains concentrated in three lenders, and the clearest recurring stress markers in the latest schedules are isolated PIK positions rather than broad markdown clusters. Golf remains the name to watch given an existing PIK position in Silverline Analytics and the standing watchlist item for rising PIK share. Hotel and Juliett each also show one PIK-paying loan in the current schedule, but from the holdings evidence alone we cannot say those are new or increased without the paired prior-period signal set.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP ($42.0mm position)
- Latest filing reviewed: 0009000011-26-000111.
- Current schedule includes one PIK-paying debt position: Silverline Analytics Inc., first lien senior secured loan, principal $12.144mm, fair value $12.120mm, PIK rate 1.5% (row 104, accession 0009000011-26-000111).
- Other larger debt marks in the schedule appear generally near par but with some discounts: Granite Peak Manufacturing senior secured loan fair value $12.880mm on $14.000mm principal (row 106, accession 0009000011-26-000111), Granite Peak delayed draw term loan fair value $12.870mm on $13.000mm principal (row 107, accession 0009000011-26-000111), Cedar Ridge Dental fair value $15.555mm on $17.000mm principal (row 102, accession 0009000011-26-000111), and Meadowbrook Pet Care fair value $12.584mm on $13.000mm principal (row 105, accession 0009000011-26-000111).
- There is also an equity position in Northwind Logistics carried at $3.400mm (row 111, accession 0009000011-26-000111).

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING ($18.0mm position)

- Largest discounts in the names shown are Brightwater Fitness Holdings, fair value $17.765mm on $19.000mm principal (row 101, accession 0009000012-26-000121), and Redwood Valley Foods, fair value $10.285mm on $11.000mm principal (row 102, accession 0009000012-26-000121).
- The rest of the schedule shown is clustered closer to par, including Tidewater Environmental at $16.881mm on $17.000mm principal (row 107, accession 0009000012-26-000121) and Fairhaven Payroll Systems at $9.940mm on $10.000mm principal (row 108, accession 0009000012-26-000121).

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC ($35.5mm position)
- Latest filing reviewed: 0009000014-26-000141.
- Current schedule includes one PIK-paying debt position: Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc., first lien term loan, principal $15.180mm, fair value $14.876mm, PIK rate 2.5% (row 106, accession 0009000014-26-000141).
- The most discounted loan in the names shown is Crestline Roofing Holdings, fair value $15.300mm on $17.000mm principal (row 103, accession 0009000014-26-000141).
- Other marks are modestly below par, including Bayview Logistics at $7.744mm on $8.000mm principal (row 102, accession 0009000014-26-000141), Elmwood Senior Living at $10.802mm on $11.000mm principal (row 105, accession 0009000014-26-000141), and Hartwell Data Centers at $17.514mm on $18.000mm principal (row 108, accession 0009000014-26-000141).

Bottom line
- Golf remains the highest-priority monitoring item for Harbor State because it is already on watch for rising PIK share, and the current schedule still shows a PIK-paying position in Silverline Analytics (row 104, accession 0009000011-26-000111).
- Hotel and Juliett each show one current PIK-paying position as well, but I would not characterize those as deterioration signals yet without the paired prior-period evidence needed to confirm they are new or increased rather than longstanding features.
- Based on the holdings evidence provided here, the schedules suggest selective borrower pressure rather than broad portfolio-wide markdown stress.
